artwork.paintingLabel: Portrait of Magin Pers Y Ramona

prompt: Generate a square image that preserves the full horizontal decorative panel inside the frame. Depict a rectangular tan wall panel bordered in brown, with a circular painted medallion at center containing the bust portrait of an older bald man with heavy mutton-chop side whiskers, dark coat, and white shirtfront, set against a deep blue-black background. Around the roundel is a gold ring with black radial accents and small round bosses. Flanking it are symmetrical gilded laurel sprays. Along the bottom, render the inscription "1803 = MAGIN PERS Y RAMONA = 1888" in pale serif capitals. Use oil paint effects, warm varnish, slightly worn surface, and historic decorative mural character.
